listing.name: Mortal Kombat Trilogy / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Build and play Mortal Kombat Trilogy on Windows or Linux with your own matching USA PlayStation disc and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. You can also use a separately prepared upstream copy.

steps.title: Download and unpack the setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder. On Linux or macOS, use native CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler. On a Mac, choose the ZIP for Apple Silicon or Intel and follow its README-SETUP.txt.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream guide for the version you downloaded. Use your own original in its supported image representation, keeping a CUE and every referenced track together when required, and supply your own BIOS whenever that guide requires it. Preserve the exact edition, disc layout and BIOS requirements in that guide; an included setup BIOS does not establish game compatibility.

steps.title: Build the game and add it to Portcove
steps.instruction: Open the project’s launcher and follow its build instructions. Keep the completed game with its required program and compiler files. In Portcove, select the completed program or supported launcher and its start folder. Save the details, then choose Play. On Mac, select build-release/Mortal_Kombat_Trilogy_Recompiled as the program and build-release as the start folder.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. Use the project’s tools for updates and back up your original files, saves and settings yourself.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own matching 30-track USA CHD (SLUS-00330) and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. A copy built with the SCPH-5552 BIOS keeps it until you update; the update needs your SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove verifies the data track and track count and builds privately with the registered toolchain. Provide all tracks; the remaining tracks are carried into preparation without authenticating their audio content. Play starts the generated runtime. Keep your original disc and BIOS separately. Windows and Linux package and source fit were statically inspected. Native build, gameplay and save compatibility remain unobserved.
